versions.changelog:
Initial release of the find-seo-agency skill.

- Find, shortlist, vet, and enrich US SEO agencies via the ServiceGraph API, filtered for technical, on-page/off-page, link-building, content, local, ecommerce, B2B, and audit services.
- Triggered by user requests for SEO agencies, SEO firm shortlists, vetting, or contact info enrichment, even when described indirectly.
- Excludes non-SEO, web development, SEM/PPC, DIY SEO, tool, and non-US requests; defers broader scopes to sibling skills.
- Provides filter DSL guidance for nuanced agency searches (sub-flavors mapped via keywords).
- Built-in API key authentication workflow and cost model; uses apex domains for firm identity.
- Usage recipes and best practices included for common scenarios.
